items.title: Financial Knowledge Systems
items.description: Chicago's financial sector — derivatives firms, banks, insurance companies, and asset managers — has substantial internal knowledge across regulatory guidance, trading protocols, compliance procedures, risk policies, and product documentation that LLM-powered RAG makes queryable in natural language. Derivatives and trading operations Q&A: RAG over CME and CBOE rulebooks, clearing procedures, margin calculations, and trading protocols — enabling operations teams to query complex derivatives market documentation instantly. Compliance knowledge management: RAG over CFTC and FINRA regulatory guidance, internal compliance policies, and examination documentation. Credit and underwriting Q&A: RAG over credit policies, underwriting guidelines, and product documentation. *All Chicago financial RAG systems include FINRA/CFTC-compliant conversation logging and appropriate financial content disclaimers.* Cost: $30,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks.
items.label: Financial Knowledge

items.title: Clinical Document Intelligence (Healthcare RAG)
items.description: For Chicago's major health systems — Advocate Aurora, Northwestern Medicine, Rush. RAG over clinical guidelines, formulary documents, clinical pathways, and internal policy documentation enabling clinicians and administrators to query clinical knowledge bases in natural language. Clinical guideline Q&A for point-of-care decision support; formulary and medication protocol querying; revenue cycle policy and payer coverage Q&A for billing staff; HR and operations policy Q&A for staff. *HIPAA-compliant infrastructure with access controls ensuring clinical staff retrieve only authorized content. BAA executed before any PHI access.* Cost: $35,000–$85,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks | HIPAA standard.
items.label: Clinical RAG

items.title: Manufacturing Documentation Intelligence
items.description: For Chicago's manufacturing sector — RAG over equipment manuals, process specifications, safety data sheets, quality standards, and engineering drawings enabling engineers and technicians to query complex technical documentation in natural language rather than searching through hundreds of PDF documents. Equipment maintenance Q&A from machine manuals and service records; process specification querying for quality engineers; safety data sheet Q&A for EHS teams; engineering change order history querying. Cost: $25,000–$65,000 | Timeline: 8–16 weeks.
